QUOTE: "The config comments say this explicitly: enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (or `_ALT`) for any multithreaded use."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros that must be enabled to get mutex protection. It also shows THREADING_C gating every lock call.
